text: Paywall/subscription required for tracking more than 3 habits. Basically useless for normal usage without expensive subscription
author: Alexander Nielsen
developer_reply: Hi Alexander, if the app helps you form 1 habit it will have already succeeded in having a big impact in your life. For free. Leaving a 1/5 review on the work of an independent developer makes it even harder for us to give more for free. Some people create, some people destroy.
